source.title: Some open problems on homogeneous compacta

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH document URL https://zbmath.org/1943955. Local shell fetching could not resolve zbmath.org or api.zbmath.org because network access is unavailable in the execution sandbox. A local workflow shard identifies zbMATH record 1943955 as 'Some open problems on homogeneous compacta', published in 2002, but does not provide a full-text link.

Access failure mode: metadata_only with network_or_dns_failure for direct shell fetching. The zbMATH URL could not be opened as a readable document through the page reader, and the zbMATH API exposed only its terms page rather than document metadata without an interactive agreement flow.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched the zbMATH identifier, exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus author, and exact title plus publication year. Candidate pages were table-of-contents listings, book-sale metadata, bibliography or citation pages, unrelated later papers, or related later discussions of homogeneous compacta rather than a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the 2002 problem statements.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source artifact was recovered. Bibliographic metadata, search snippets, tables of contents, and related works were not treated as the technical source.

The source-adequacy and evidence-completeness gates forbid accepting questions extracted only from metadata, citation records, tables of contents, search snippets, or related-but-distinct works. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/1943955.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
